summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) screen-reader announce-on-nav bug fix and (2) removal of 'How It Works' from sidebar. All 19 assertions passed. Sidebar no longer contains nav-how-it-works; remaining 7 items (Home/Features/Demo/Dashboard/Localize/History/Analytics) are present. With SR OFF, sr-live-region remains empty on navigation. Toggling SR ON updates button text to 'Screen Reader: ON', sets aria-pressed=true, and announces 'Screen reader enabled. You are on the <Page> page.'. Subsequent sidebar clicks (Demo/Localize/Home/Features) correctly update sr-live-region to '<Name> page'. Toggling OFF stops future announcements (region retains previous value; not updated on next nav). /how-it-works route still loads (CTA target intact). Protected /dashboard route redirects to /login while logged out. /demo still exposes run-demo-btn. No console errors observed on route changes or toggling.
critical_code_review_comments: A11yContext.announce uses setAnnouncement('') then setTimeout 50ms — works but consider using a monotonically-changing key/counter to avoid missed announcements when identical text is spoken twice in a row.
When toggling SR OFF, the sr-live-region retains the last announcement text. Per spec that's acceptable (it just stops updating), but consider clearing it on disable for cleanliness.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Screen-reader a11y and sidebar changes verified end-to-end via Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reusable pattern: read [data-testid=sr-live-region] .text_content() ~300-400ms after each navigation; announce delays ~50ms internally. nav-how-it-works must remain absent from sidebar but /how-it-works route stays reachable via landing CTA.
